THE_GATE_FIRST.post_inspect_prompt_gate: 300 distinct prompts / 300 episodes, ratio 1.000, largest identical group 1, VERDICT FIT
THE_GATE_FIRST.bound: a high ratio is NECESSARY, not sufficient. 300 distinct programs guarantee 300 distinct prompts and that alone says nothing about whether the STATE encodes the bug region. The permutation control, PCA-8 and n=100 are the other side and run beside the probe.

the_structure.reading: trajectories are nearly all unique; outcomes are not, because 244 of 300 fail at the budget wall. That is outcome RESOLUTION, not degeneracy -- the budget probe showed doubling the budget converts 6 of 65 and loses 3.

and_the_number_that_is_new: SE 2.2 POINTS. Every rate before this in the programme rested on 11 or 12 deterministic outcomes and had no honest interval at all. This is the first v-set where an effect of a few points could be distinguished from noise.
bounds: 18.7% here against 18.8% on the provisional 80 is AGREEMENT, not replication: the 80 were generated from the same seed BEFORE the P1' filter existed, so they are a different draw from the same generator, not an independent set. The independent replication set is seed 47 and is unrun.
